evidence: Isolates legacy wallet migration and loading routines into `src/wallet/legacy/` and introduces a `LegacyWallet` subclass.
rationale: This refactor cleanly separates legacy migration routines from descriptor wallet code to avoid accidental calls and reduce maintenance overhead. The author notes that having legacy wallet code co-mingled with descriptor code 'makes it difficult to implement new things into the wallet,' but this is primarily internal code organization without direct user-facing changes.
